{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma2oa
|version1= 1.52

|game2= tkoh
|version2= 1.00

|game3= arma3
|version3= 0.50

|arg= local

|eff= global

|gr1= Turrets

|descr= Removes all magazines of the given type from given vehicle. Use turret path [-1] for driver's turret.

|s1= vehicle [[removeMagazinesTurret]] [magazineName, turretPath]

|p1= vehicle: [[Object]]

|p2= magazineName: [[String]]

|p3= turretPath: [[Turret Path]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>vehicle player removeMagazinesTurret ["60rnd_CMFlareMagazine", [-1]];</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>_tank removeMagazinesTurret ["20Rnd_120mmSABOT_M1A2", [0]];</sqf>

|seealso= [[removeAllMagazinesTurret]] [[addMagazineTurret]] [[removeAllMagazines]] [[magazinesTurret]] [[removeMagazineTurret]] [[weaponsTurret]] [[addWeaponTurret]] [[removeWeaponTurret]] [[turretLocal]]
}}

{{Note
|user= Kylania
|timestamp= 20110730184200
|text= Here's how you would remove all machine gun ammo from an M1A2 TUSK:<br>
remove the gunner's M240 ammo.
<sqf>this removeMagazinesTurret ["1200Rnd_762x51_M240", [0]];</sqf>

remove the commander's M2 ammo.
<sqf>this removeMagazinesTurret ["100Rnd_127x99_M2", [0, 0]];</sqf>

remove the loader's M240 ammo.
<sqf>this removeMagazinesTurret ["100Rnd_762x51_M240", [0, 1]];</sqf>
}}
